interp: The fund's 3-month return (-1.70%) reflects sharp divergence between exchange and platform winners and deep corrections across industrial and capital goods suppliers.

portfolio.line: High-beta ELSS portfolio balancing exchange and digital platform gains against heavy cyclical drawdowns in capital goods and defence-linked manufacturing.
